units: pixels (x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (phase correlation frame0 vs frame41 on the upper image: shift (-0.01, 0.00) px; background identical apart from the car)
camera.view: level camera looking straight down the parking-garage aisle; light-tube lines converge at a vanishing point ~(960, 540) = image centre, so the optical axis is ~horizontal and parallel to the aisle
camera.focal_length: unknown (estimate from given depth_info + a known size: f_px = pixel_size * depth / world_size)

car.description: yellow sports coupe (RX-7 style, rear spoiler, white 5-spoke rims); the only moving object
car.visible_frames: 0-40 (frame 41: fully hidden behind the left near pillar)
car.fully_visible_frames: 22-27 (before 22 the rear is behind the right near pillar at x>=1831; from 28 the front is behind the left near pillar at x<=95)
car.motion_summary: frames 0-13: drives out of the right parking bay (behind the right near pillar), yawing from nose-toward-camera to side-on and moving toward the camera (contact line y 809 -> 877); frames ~14-40: side-on, driving straight to the LEFT across the image at ~constant depth (contact y ~880, wheel axle y ~793), image shift per frame grows 67 px (f12->13) to ~101 px (f27-31), then falls to ~94 px (f36->37) and ~80 px (f38-40, low reliability)

side_on_pixel_size.length_note: front bumper to rear (spoiler/rear bumper) along x, rows above contact-45 px; frames 22-27: 1161,1154,1153,1154,1158,1153
side_on_pixel_size.height_note: roof top y 528 to ground contact y ~882 (contact from shadow line, +-4 px)
side_on_pixel_size.apparent_size_change: constant within ~1% from frame ~16 to 37 (constant depth, side-on); before frame 14 the car is yawed and partially hidden, apparent size grows as it approaches

left_near_pillar.description: concrete pillar at the left image edge, closest to camera; occludes the car from frame 28 on

right_near_pillar.description: concrete pillar at the right image edge with a red fire extinguisher; occludes the car's rear until frame 21

left_mid_pillar.description: second pillar on the left (fire extinguisher on its right face), hazard stripes at its base

right_mid_pillar.description: second pillar on the right with a small yellow 'B1'

fire_extinguisher_left.description: red extinguisher on the left mid pillar

fire_extinguisher_right.description: red extinguisher on the right near pillar (closer, larger)

B1_sign_back_wall.description: large yellow 'B1' painted on the far back wall

B1_sign_left_pillar.description: yellow 'B1' on the left near pillar

floor_marking.description: white painted trapezoid (arrow stem) on the floor at bottom centre, cut by the image bottom

back_wall_floor_line.description: where the far back wall meets the floor

parking_bays.description: green-floored bays left and right behind the pillars; the car emerges from the right bay

events.event: video starts with the car already moving: front of car visible between right mid pillar and right near pillar (x 1760-1831), nose toward camera
car turns out of the right parking bay into the aisle (yaw change ~90 deg, moving toward camera then left)
car essentially side-on, from here moves straight left at constant depth
rear clears the right near pillar: first fully visible frame
front starts disappearing behind the left near pillar
peak image speed ~101 px/frame; afterwards the car slows (shift 94 px at f36->37)
render artifact: visible tail drawn as a smeared yellow blob
car completely hidden behind the left near pillar
